scope: Recovered run of a small first-person puzzle authored from a blank project with the portable Windows x64 creator and an installed Claude Code ACP adapter. The harness supplied the approved brief, the C# project and API references, operated the compiler and attached its output. The agent authored the scene, UI definitions and gameplay source.

failures: The room and puzzle props committed before the first authoring turn reached its seven-minute harness deadline.
The continuation saved the HUD and C# source. The product retired the agent connection with the prompt outcome unknown before it displayed a completion. The harness deadline then expired.

publisher.observation: A normal Python import from an installed pack generated tools/__pycache__, and the strict pack inventory rejected it. The tested game used the original publisher with Python -B.
publisher.fix_verified: Built a separate 17-resource authoring pack containing the publisher fix and published the same game source with a normal Python invocation. The validator admitted the pack again after publication.

remaining: A full successful authoring turn reported in the workspace
Verification results tied to the build shown in the creator
Revision, working-build retention and restart-safe recovery through the creator UI
First-time creator qualification on a fresh setup
